matches.rationale: Finding 1 identifies that deposit sends message.amount, the lamport value, to the treasury instead of the full wei amount, so the rest stays in EtherBridge.
Finding 14 notes that in withdraw.rs the relayer account is not checked against RELAYER_PUBKEY, whereas deposit does check it.
Finding 6 is muddled, but it does say withdraw passes message.amount, which is in lamports, straight to the treasury, which expects wei. That is the unit mismatch in EtherBridge.withdraw.
The report has no finding about test coverage.
The report does not flag the missing zero-address checks on the relayer, destination or recipient.
Finding 4 flags that receiveMessage calls the router before marking the nonce as received, and recommends checks-effects-interactions.
